scope: Independent CPU-only fixture, precision configuration, provenance, and planning-estimate review of fixed 108-row HiFi2 panel. No launch, device work, or stage signoff.

panel.result: The same 108 (36 onsets × seeds 42/43/44) keys as proposal-c are retained. Exactly the 29 old cap512 rows selected in the refreshed second-cap provenance move to cap1024; the other 79 rows keep their prior cap (72 at256 and7 at512).
panel.input_check: For all 108 rows, source_onset/seed identities match proposal-c; prompt IDs, chosen continuations, sampling metadata, and metadata.seed match the corresponding saved source input. Extension fixtures match exact inputs across served/full duplicate checks recorded by provenance.
panel.source_hashes: All 64 provenance source-file hashes, selected extension fixture hashes, and all runtime-estimate source-result hashes were checked against disk.
panel.branch_policy: Every candidate row has branches=[], one free-running trial, and per-row cap matching the frozen or promoted cap.

precision.finding: Configuration is BFP8 lm_head with HiFi2 compute fidelity; remaining groups and policy stay as in proposal-c.
precision.path_note: The build-kwargs path resolves and its bytes exactly match the local precision file hash above.

forecast.formula: Use observed per-trial diagnostic wall for caps256/512; for cap1024 use measured cap512 prefill/host overhead plus decode_wall_s × 1023/511. Sum 108 cases; add one measured served load and fixed180s prep allowance; range scales case work 0.7x–1.5x with load/prep fixed.
forecast.recalculation: All 108 source trial hashes and values, case sum, total, and range endpoints recompute exactly. Seconds/hours fields also agree.
forecast.prep_note: The 180s allowance is an explicit planning margin, not a measured HiFi2 first-preparation duration.

command_review.compare_dir: omitted for branches=[] free-run-only rows; later adjudication must compare token streams by source_onset+seed

limitations: No candidate outputs or semantic behavior were reviewed because the panel has not run.
This is preparation review only, not admission or stage signoff.
